turns.prompt:
Create a precinct anomaly evidence wall for a county election night command briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one precinct anomaly evidence wall in the first viewport.

Situation: County: Arroyo. Precincts P12, P18, P31, P44, central scanner, ballot drop site D7, observer desk, legal hotline.
Current state: P12 turnout spike amber, P18 scanner jam red, P31 provisional queue 46, P44 normal, D7 chain-of-custody check pending, hotline volume 18 calls.
Timeline: 18:10 turnout spike, 18:25 scanner jam, 18:40 provisional queue, 19:00 D7 check, 19:30 legal review, 20:00 canvass checkpoint.
Sources: S1 pollbook feed, S2 scanner log, S3 provisional roster, S4 drop-site log, S5 observer note, S6 legal hotline digest.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover P18 scanner jam, P31 provisional queue, D7 custody check, hotline volume. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the county clerk. Preserve the anomaly wall; add exactly three public-comms decisions: explain P18 delay, protect provisional voters, verify D7 custody. Add two leader-linked lenses for scanner recovery and provisional queue.

Apply a 19:35 correction: P18 scanner is cleared, P31 queue falls to 21, D7 custody verified, but P12 turnout spike remains under review. Synchronize wall, decisions, timeline, legend, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave P18 shown as jammed.
Turn it into a bipartisan observer packet. Fit the anomaly wall, current status ledger, three decisions, S1-S6 evidence tags, and chain-of-custody timeline into the first viewport.

Add a public website snapshot preview beside the observer packet. It must preserve P18 cleared, P31 queue 21, D7 verified, P12 under review, and all source markers, while the full packet remains visible.
